mapper.select: select id from sys_user where username = #{username} and is_deleted = false for share
mapper.insert: insert into vault_account ( id, owner_id, webauthn_user_handle, create_user, update_user ) values ( #{id}, #{ownerId}, #{handle}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerId} ) on conflict (owner_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select * from vault_account where owner_id = #{ownerId} for update

select a.* from vault_account a join sys_user u ON u.id = a.owner_id where a.owner_id = #{ownerId} and a.is_deleted = false and u.is_deleted = false and u.status = 1 and not exists (select 1 from vault_info v where v.account_id = a.id and v.is_deleted = true)
select * from vault_info where account_id = #{accountId} and is_deleted = false for update
select * from vault_rotation where vault_id = #{vaultId} and rotation_id = #{rotationId} and is_deleted = false for update
select owner_id from vault_account where id = #{accountId}
select a.owner_id from vault_account a join vault_info v ON v.account_id = a.id where v.id = #{vaultId}
select coalesce(max(generation), 0) from vault_generation where vault_id = #{vaultId}

select * from vault_session_revocation_outbox where is_deleted = false and ((status = 'PENDING' and available_at <= clock_timestamp()) or (status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until <= clock_timestamp())) order by available_at, id limit 20 for update skip locked
select * from vault_rotation where status = 'UPLOADING' AND is_deleted = false and expires_at <= clock_timestamp() order by expires_at limit 20

select a.owner_id from public.vault_account a join public.vault_info v on v.account_id = a.id where a.is_deleted = false and v.is_deleted = false and ( exists (select 1 from public.vault_item i where i.vault_id = v.id and i.is_deleted = true and i.gmt_deleted <= #{itemBefore}) or exists (select 1 from public.vault_key_slot s where s.vault_id = v.id and s.is_deleted = true and s.gmt_deleted <= #{before}) or exists (select 1 from public.vault_generation g where g.vault_id = v.id and g.is_deleted = false and g.status in ('RETIRED', 'ABORTED') and g.retired_at <= #{before}) ) and not exists (select 1 from public.vault_rotation r where r.vault_id = v.id and r.status = 'UPLOADING' and r.is_deleted = false) order by least( (select min(i.gmt_deleted) from public.vault_item i where i.vault_id = v.id and i.is_deleted = true), (select min(s.gmt_deleted) from public.vault_key_slot s where s.vault_id = v.id and s.is_deleted = true), (select min(g.retired_at) from public.vault_generation g where g.vault_id = v.id and g.is_deleted = false) ), a.owner_id limit 20
select * from public.vault_account where owner_id = #{ownerId} and is_deleted = false for update skip locked
select * from public.vault_info where account_id = #{accountId} and is_deleted = false for update skip locked
select min(gmt_deleted) from public.vault_item where is_deleted = true and gmt_deleted <= #{before}
mapper.delete: delete from vault_key_slot where id in ( select s.id from vault_key_slot s join vault_info v on v.id = s.vault_id where s.vault_id = #{vaultId} and s.is_deleted = true and s.gmt_deleted <= #{before} and not exists (select 1 from vault_rotation r where r.vault_id = v.id and r.status = 'UPLOADING') limit 100 for update of s skip locked )
